title: (1) Johnnie Walker Red Label Blended Scotch Whisky, Scotland, 375ml, 42.3% ABV (Bottled in NZ) (TOL)

not_in_title: Label states 74 PROOF, not 42.3% ABV (title converts it). Old bottling by The Distillers Co (NZ) Ltd, Auckland, with Highest Awards strip label; flask bottle and 375ml size; label has a worn/scraped patch on the awards strip. No barcode seen.
reason: Title is right on facts but undersells the vintage: flask-shaped old NZ-bottled Red Label with the DCL (NZ) label is a niche NZ collectable. Likely modest value uplift only.

title_errors: none (title says 42.3% ABV; label says 74 proof, which is the same strength)
condition: Fill high shoulder to neck base, slight tarnish on labels, scraped patch on awards strip, capsule dented/marked. TOL noted by Webb's.
unreadable: Awards strip right-hand text partly scraped away; neck label small print
